    Online RSVP, elegant & easy

    Beautiful online RSVP website for wedding & other events.

    Create a beautiful Event website, send your online invitations, track your guests responses.
    It takes 5 mins to setup, and costs $25 only!

    Get started
    Explore 100s Designs
    

    The most beautiful

    Modern & elegant templates designed by professionals... or create your own!
    

    The easiest to use

    Drag, drop, edit, re-arrange. Pick your colors, fonts, photos. It takes 3mins to setup your event!
    

    Advanced features

    Customize your event as you need and manage answers through advanced dashboard.
    

    $25 only

    No advertising. No subscription or recurring fee. Unlimited guest list + all features included.
    How does it work?
    Create your Event website Invite your guests to respond Track your RSVPs
    Pick a design
    Choose amongst 100s of professional themes: wedding, elegant, modern, classic, floral, watercolor, geometric... and more!
    We have a beautiful design for every RSVP.
    Check the  RSVP Website demo
    Match your paper invitations
    You can pick an existing template or upload your own design to match your paper invitations. It will display beautifully both on desktop and mobile.
    Customise in 2 mins
    Pick your fonts, change colors, upload your photos.
    Add Event info: Location, Schedule, Contact, Accommodations...
    Drag, drop, customise to create the perfect RSVP website in few minutes.
    Add custom questions or secondary events
    You can add sub-events (e.g. Ceremony rehearsal) or ask your guests their menu selection, dietary requirements, music preferrences, etc.
    Choose your event address
    Create a custom address for your RSVP like:
    http://romeo-juliet.online-rsvp.com
    Accept payments
    Collect donations, get registry gifts or sell tickets directly on your Event page.
    It is very easy to setup and very convenient to use!
    Super quick and easy
    Your guests can respond in less than 1 minute.
    No need for them to register or download an App.
    Send invitations / reminders
    Import your guest list and send e-mail or text invitations directly from Online-RSVP.
    You can also send reminders to the guests who have not RSVP yet.
    Make your event private
    You can add a password to your event to protect it, or restict RSVPs to Guest-List only.
    Control +1s
    You can limit the number of +1s for each of your Guests, or use default for all Guests.
    Advanced Dashboard
    Manage all your guest responses in one place. Get separate lists for each question and keep track of your event anywhere - from your computer or your mobile.
    Check the  Dashboard demo
    Get e-mail notifications
    Get an alert when one of your guest reply to your event. You can choose daily notifications, after each RSVP, or deactivate these e-mails. You can also add another address in CC.
    Download Excel lists
    Export your list of guests into an Excel / (Mac) Numbers / Google Sheets files - to save on your computer or send to your Vendors.
    They used it, they loved it!
        
    I was looking for a pretty RSVP website for our wedding, matching our paper invitations.
    Online-RSVP was a great solution! Very simple to customize, select matching fonts, upload your logo, etc. The result was brilliant! Definitely recommend it!
    Annabelle, New York
        
    I spent a long time searching for the most beautiful way to track our wedding RSVP.
    I was not willing to use any of these 90s-looking pages, or tacky 'fake envelops opening' videos.
    We've found the best solution: chic, elegant and personnalized. Just like our big day :-)
    Michelle, United Kingdom
        
    Our wedding was very simple: intimate, no frills, close friends and family. Our invitations had to be the same. Online-RSVP made the whole organization so simple. Guests just had to do few clicks. We just had to download the lists. Convenient and efficient. Thanks a lot!
    Karen, Florida
        
    My husband and I had a big debate: I was a little bit reluctant using a RSVP website…
    Is it formal enough? Will older people be able to use?
    We finally chose the online solution - and we don't regret it at all! The whole thing was so convient - yet elegant and modern. Our guests also really liked it. My friends want to use the same service too now :-)
    Brianne, California
        
    I was initially willing to find a free online RSVP service.
    Why pay when you can get the same for free? But I got very quickly annoyed by the limitations and hard pushes for the 'premium' versions. Above all, the ads starting to appear on our page were a deal breaker.
    We've ended up spending $20,000+ for our wedding. That $25 fee was acceptable, for a beautiful page and great service. Thanks!
    Judy, Boston
